research.committee: Mean probabilities are normalised. Unanimity uses coordinatewise minimum of both probabilities as an EV decision score, NOT a renormalised probability distribution or statistical confidence bound. Choose at most one eligible outcome by this score.
research.daily_cap_limitation: Retrospective proportional daily allocation, not an exact sequential live staking process.

features.football: Frozen enriched prior-day design; no closing prices, Pinnacle, xG or invented injuries.
features.ufc: Frozen enriched design plus minimum experience, mean age, max layoff; no 2025+ input.
features.wta: Audited prior-day cross_book_form plus surface context for trees; class0=P1. No uncorrected rolling features. No 2026 data.

research.fit: Annual fit strictly before Jan1 minus7days, completed training only. Fit transformations on training only. Binary orientation symmetrised. No random split, early stopping or evaluation-dependent changes.
research.gate: Each variant separately: >=50 settled tuning and positive tuning ROI and ordinary95pct lower. Then >=200 settled evaluation, positive ROI2/5pct, corrected lower>0, >=2 positive years, positive without best profit year. No real-money authorisation even if passed.
research.hypothesis: Recent shallow trees and regularised linear corrections may agree on more stable price errors. Compare each component, fixed equal average and unanimous positive-EV gate. No post-result subgroup or threshold search.
research.staking: flat only; no Kelly or martingale search

uncertainty.scope: 264 previous nominal comparisons +6 WTA +12 here. Does not cover all adaptive research. Circular3month blocks; extreme tail is Monte-Carlo approximation.

wta_features.execution_book: B365 historical edition; not demonstrated equal to bet365.fr
wta_features.fit_rule: once at Jan 1 of test year, only earlier completed matches strictly before Jan 1 minus embargo
wta_features.hypothesis: A learned symmetric residual can use bookmaker disagreement and lagged player information to select better WTA bets than calibration of a single price.
wta_features.imputation: nonfinite signed lagged differences replaced by zero; symmetric neutral prior
limitations: Per-bookmaker odds not timestamped, may not be simultaneous
Historical price editions not proven available in France
Lagged features inherited from prior audited pipeline
Repeatedly inspected history cannot confirm a strategy
Conditional void rules must be matched to a real operator before execution
wta_features.model: ridge residual around B365 log odds, symmetric augmented training and predictions
wta_features.reference_book: Pinnacle historical Tennis-Data; not a ground-truth probability

selection.bankroll: 1000 initial; all bets on same day use start-of-day bankroll, proportional daily cap; no reinvestment within day
selection.criterion: highest EV among eligible outcomes, without using match status
selection.noncompleted_settlement: void; kept in selection and exposure, final status only used at settlement
selection.sensitivity: same selections and primary stakes; only payouts change

uncertainty.bootstrap: circular moving blocks of 3 months including no-bet months; profit divided by exposure
uncertainty.scope: corrects these six configurations only, not earlier project searches
